question: Does the newly located NIA notice for the August 2025 Magapuy–Paitan flora/fauna inventory publish fish species or a reusable freshwater checklist?

sourcesReviewed.citation: National Irrigation Administration–Nueva Vizcaya Irrigation Management Office. (2025-09-03). Tubig Para sa Bukid: Pagsusuri sa Kalikasan Isinagawa Para sa Magapuy - Paitan INIP.
sourcesReviewed.reportedScope: A flora and fauna inventory in Barangays Paitan and Magapuy, Bayombong, conducted by NIA-NVIMO with DENR-PENRO, MENRO, an irrigators association and barangay officials as part of the Magapuy-Paitan INIP pre-feasibility study.

sourcesReviewed.citation: National Irrigation Administration–Nueva Vizcaya Irrigation Management Office. (2025-06-19). Diving into Data: Ongoing Freshwater Ecology Survey for Magapuy-Paitan INIP.
sourcesReviewed.reportedScope: An earlier freshwater ecology survey in the same barangays; the notice describes net sampling and a second phase collecting fish caught using traditional traps.

sourcesReviewed.citation: National Irrigation Administration–Nueva Vizcaya Irrigation Management Office. (2026-03-05). Baseline Water Quality Sampling for Magapuy-Paitan Pre-Feasibility Study.

findings: The August inventory notice confirms survey activity and broad localities, but lists no fish or other taxon names, sampling stations, coordinates, vouchers, counts, or species-level results.
The quadrat and riparian methods in the August notice are not identified as fish-capture or aquatic fish-identification methods. Do not interpret the general flora/fauna inventory as a fish survey.

The May–June fish-trap/net work is reported by a separate notice with different dates and methods. Do not combine its effort or potential results with the August flora/fauna inventory unless an underlying report establishes the relationship.

A bounded exact-title and project-name search found the NIA field notices and project-context pages but no publicly accessible final ecology report, species checklist, fish table, or linked data file. This is a search result, not proof that no report exists.
The March 2026 water-quality notice names four sampling areas but reports planned laboratory analysis, not fish observations or results.
limitations: The notices provide no biological sampling coordinates, station crosswalk, datum, voucher/accession identifiers, full methods, or item-specific reuse terms for the underlying surveys.
Barangay names do not identify a particular river, creek, lake, reach, or catchment. Do not map the inventory to a waterbody based on the irrigation project name.
Water-quality monitoring is not fish presence or absence evidence, and an unpublished or unlocated report must not be inferred from project status notices.

disposition.sourceUse: Research-only access lead for locating the underlying Magapuy–Paitan environmental and freshwater survey reports.

nextAction: Continue searching public NIA/DENR environmental assessment files and repository catalogues for the Magapuy-Paitan pre-feasibility study. If a report is found, verify whether it includes an aquatic fish survey, dated species records, station crosswalk, identifications/vouchers, and reuse terms before any extraction.

Magapuy-Paitan INIP flora and fauna inventory report
NIA Region II Magapuy Paitan fish survey species 2025 2026
searchScope.scopeLimit: Bounded public search and official page review; no login, direct inquiry, download of a non-public file, or data request was made.

sources.supports: Official NIA Region II report of the 27–28 August 2025 flora/fauna inventory and its rapid/quadrat/riparian methods.
Separate official NIA Region II report of the May–June 2025 freshwater ecology and fish-trap sampling activity.
Official NIA Region II notice of 27 February 2026 water-quality sampling; no fish results are published there.
